title: [US] TikTok Shop Partner Tiering Mechanism
label: TIKTOK SHOP · PARTNER GUIDE
subtitle: Updated 2026-06-30
html:
The TikTok Shop Partners (TSP) Tiering System is designed to cultivate a robust ecosystem, set service benchmarks, and offer customized resources for TSP at various development stages—thereby guiding their growth path. The version will take effect starting from April, and the partner's tier for April will be based on this version. This Tiering Mechanism only applies to TikTok Shop Partners certified and operating in the US market. This is the previous version for your reference. [External] TTS-US TikTok Shop Partner Tiering Mechanism_202509 [External] TTS-US TikTok Shop Partner Tiering Mechanism_202506

Partner Tier Update

  • Comprehensive: We incorporate additional dimensions to more holistically evaluate partners' merchant incubation performance. We also introduce a new merchant acquisition metric, with higher weighting for partners that integrate acquisition and operations, encouraging them to strengthen merchant recruitment while continuing to provide strong operational support for existing merchants.

Rules for TSP Tiering

TSP Tiers

  • For Regular Type TSPs

TSPs will be divided into 6 tiers from V0 to V5, corresponding to the ++V0 TSP -> V1 Certified TSP -> V2 Bronze TSP -> V3 Silver TSP -> V4 Gold TSP -> V5 Platinum++ TSP levels. The higher the partner's rating, the stronger its comprehensive promotion capabilities.

TSP Tier Update Schedule

  • The TSP tier will be updated on the 3rd~5th day of each following month, and it will be calculated according to the performance data of the partner in the previous month.
  • There may be a delay in updating the tiering results, and the actual update will be based on the notification within the product.
  • The tiering result is automatically calculated by the system based on various indicators. Since it is not a point-deduction system, appeals are not supported yet.

Rights and Benefits of Different TSP Tiers

  • The platform grants TSPs different rights and benefits based on their tier levels and makes timely adjustments according to the rollout schedule of these benefits.
  • The rights and benefits available to TSPs at different tiers include, but are not limited to: access to honor awards, account/store protect and appeal, livestream support, exclusive event privileges, operation support, and more.
  • The different rights and benefits are matched according to the tier level of the TSP agency, and the specific approval standards follow the overall requirements. (To be continued)

How to check Partner Tiering on TikTok Shop Partner Center?

All the tiering labels can be visible on TikTok Shop Partner Center( https://partner.us.tiktokshop.com/） After logging in, partners will receive a notification to review the new tiering rules after the partner tier is officially launched. Click "View the Introduction" to understand the tier mechanism and corresponding benefits.

  • Local partners can check tiering badges on the Profile Page, Home Page, Role Switch Page, etc.
  • Cross-border partners can view tiering badges on the Home Page.

Partners can view details about the definition of each tier by hovering over the tiering badge. Please note: Currently, tiering badges are only displayed for V1-V5 partners. V0 partners will not show a badge at this time.

  1. The platform reserves the right to adjust these rules in accordance with its development and operational management needs, and will publicly announce any changes. Once these rules take effect, continued use of the platform services by TikTok Shop Partners("TSP") will be deemed as acceptance and acknowledgment of the rules. If a TSP disagrees with these rules or any revised rules, it may follow the platform's guidelines to apply for discontinuation of the platform services.
